literal_meaning: ঘুঘু (পাখি, যেমন ঘুঘু পাখি বা কবুতরের মতো)
figurative_meaning_en: Used in praise for someone skilled or exceptionally experienced
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা সত্যিকারের ঘুঘু, সবকিছুতে দক্ষ।
তার বুদ্ধির প্রশংসায় আমরা তাকে ঘুঘু বলে ডাকি।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real ghughu, skilled in everything.
We call him ghughu to praise his intelligence.
history: References Bengali folk tradition where the dove (ghughu) symbolizes cleverness, as noted in works like those by Prathom Chowdhury.
note: The idiom draws from the perceived wisdom of the dove in rural Bengali culture.
